_comment: Repositories to scan for skills. type 'collection' walks the whole repo tree looking for files whose name is in 'match'. type 'single' points at one exact 'path' (for repos that hold just one skill). 'exclude'/'excludePrefixes' skip paths; 'excludeDotDirs' skips any path whose first segment starts with '.'; 'includePrefix' restricts a scan to only paths under that prefix (used when a repo duplicates the same skills across many languages/locales — see wasabeef below). Add sources here — the next scheduled run (daily) or a manual workflow_dispatch picks them up automatically. Every entry here has been verified to actually contain SKILL.md files (or the Codex equivalent) via the GitHub API before being added, not just assumed from a README claim.
